items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-12-30
items.q: And there was some trouble there, if I recall, about Larry playing there.

ctx.x: They had a little trouble in the audience when you played there. Because I recall it really well.
Yeah. The Suburban Garden was an exclusive white place. And there was some trouble there, if I recall, about Larry playing there. Frank asked you some questions, too.
And I thought maybe I'd follow up on him just to help him out. What about Sid Isles?
